race.comment: ZORRO'S FLIGHT (7) can bounce back. He was firmly in the market in Saturday company last time at Caulfield Heath but didn't have the best of runs and finished near the tail. The win prior at Sale was strong and this is far more suitable back to a mile and back in grade. ZEBRA FINCH (8) led and won a four horse race two back, good again last time behind an in-form horse at Caulfield Heath. He maps nicely and can return to winning ways. POLITELY DUN (5) got home nicely off a strong tempo first up at Flemington to grab fourth. Likely gets a long way back again but look for him late if the tempo is on. RAF ATTACK (2) was solid fresh in the same race at a big price and is in the mix from LAKE VOSTOK (10) who is good enough on her day and gets Shinn on.
